title: Colombia announces end of aerial glyphosate spraying of coca
detail: The president announced in May 2015 that Colombia would suspend aerial fumigation of coca, used since the 1990s.

title: Colombia signs peace agreement with the FARC
detail: Final accord signed 24 Nov 2016 and approved by Congress days later. Crisis Group links the FARC's demobilization to trafficking networks shifting toward Ecuador.

title: Colombian coca hits a record 253,000 ha
detail: UNODC's 2023 survey: coca up 10% on 2022; potential cocaine production up 53%.

title: Guayaquil prison massacre kills at least 116
detail: Gang clashes in the Litoral Penitentiary, the worst prison massacre in Ecuador's history.

title: Presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio assassinated
detail: Shot at a campaign rally in Quito during Ecuador's record-violence year.

title: Ecuador declares an internal armed conflict
detail: President Noboa designated 22 gangs as terrorist groups and deployed the military. Murders fell 17% in 2024 before rising again in 2025.

title: Spain's largest cocaine seizure: 13 t in bananas from Ecuador
detail: Intercepted at the port of Algeciras, the biggest single cocaine haul in Spanish history.

title: Antwerp seizes a record 116 t of cocaine
detail: Up from 110 t in 2022 and about 40 t in 2017. Colombia, Ecuador and Panama named as main source countries.

title: Santos port: over 27 t of cocaine seized in a year
detail: Latin America's largest port is a main exit for Europe-bound cocaine, with the PCC loading shipments. Seizures there later fell as flows moved to other Brazilian ports.

title: Taliban ban opium poppy cultivation
detail: The April 2022 decree cut Afghan cultivation from 233,000 ha (2022) to 10,800 ha (2023); opium output fell from 6,200 t to 333 t.

title: Military coup in Myanmar
detail: UNODC: the economic, security and governance disruption after the February 2021 takeover drove farmers in remote areas toward opium.

title: Myanmar overtakes Afghanistan as top opium producer
detail: 1,080 t of opium in 2023 (up 36%) on 47,100 ha, with the largest growth in Shan State.

title: Asia's largest drug bust: 55.6 million meth pills in Laos
detail: Found in a beer truck in Bokeo province, with 1.5 t of crystal meth. Linked to networks in Myanmar's Shan State.

title: Record 190 t of meth seized in East and Southeast Asia
detail: UNODC: seizures up from 151 t in 2022, while prices kept falling, a sign that supply from Shan State grew faster than seizures.

title: About 3,000 kg of heroin seized at Mundra port
detail: India's largest heroin seizure, in a consignment linked to Afghanistan.

title: Thailand removes cannabis from its narcotics list
detail: Effectively decriminalized use and possession; about 4,200 prisoners released. Restricted to medical use in June 2025.

title: Legal retail cannabis opens in Colorado and Washington
detail: DEA: Mexican marijuana in US markets has been largely supplanted by domestic production.

title: Border Patrol marijuana seizures fall to a historic low
detail: About 155,000 lb in FY2022, down from nearly 3 million lb at the 2013 peak.
